method: Actual final-video contact sheet, source/candidate frames, exact caption boundary panel, focused frame OCR, decoded-pixel boundary measurements, source/mix provenance and independently worded local Whisper base/small transcription. No direct human/independent listening.
lesson: Use integer frame intervals at scene boundaries; do not copy rounded seconds directly into end-exclusive video text comparisons. Resolve ambiguous very short TTS ASR by a second local model and actual final-mix checks before another paid synthesis.
limitations: Same-Agent self-review only; no independent reviewer, direct human listening, user acceptance or company acceptance.
Local glyph restoration approximates hair, fabric and wall texture in formerly occluded letter regions; subtle repair traces remain. Original faces, identity and source cut/wipe motion are preserved.
UVR separation inside narration windows is approximate; this is not a claim of lossless music/effect separation or human verification of every effect.
One KIE audio-understanding request returned business code 500 with no task/response billing receipt. Its final charge remains unknown and reserved; no duplicate model POST was made.
curation_boundary: Existing task records checked; selected contact sheets inspected. No new full-video or listening review; omitted historical paths are not live dependencies.
